facts.heading: Marriage ended after 15 years
facts.content: Jana and Radka were married for 15 years.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, Radka and I decided to divorce.

facts.heading: Divorce decision in Croatia
facts.content: Jana learned of the divorce decision while they were in Croatia.
facts.evidence: We were still in Croatia.

facts.heading: Divorce notice in September
facts.content: Radka told Jana in September that the marriage was no longer possible.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it's not possible anymore.

facts.heading: Jana's emotional reaction to news
facts.content: Jana felt emptiness and anger 30 times a day after the news.
facts.evidence: Empty. Then anger. Then again emptiness. 30 times a day.

facts.heading: Radka's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radka explained that they pretended to live next to each other.
facts.evidence: He said we pretended to live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana's self-blame regarding marriage
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have noticed the signs of the marriage ending.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I'm blind.

facts.heading: Jana's thoughts on her role
facts.content: Jana sometimes thinks she was too tired or too worried.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired and I didn't care about her.

facts.heading: Jana has two children
facts.content: Jana has two children named Anička and Matěj.
facts.evidence: I have two kids. Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.

facts.heading: Children's names and ages
facts.content: Anička is 12 years old and Matěj is 8 years old.
facts.evidence: Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.

facts.heading: Delaying telling children about divorce
facts.content: Jana and Radka have been postponing telling the children about the divorce.
facts.evidence: we keep postponing it.

facts.heading: Anička's recent question to Jana
facts.content: Last week, Anička asked Jana if they were arguing with her dad.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were arguing with dad.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička about the divorce, and Anička knew.
facts.evidence: Because I lied to her. And she knew it.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of telling children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of the children's tears when telling them the truth.
facts.evidence: But I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Jana's view on her impact on Anička
facts.content: Jana feels she might destroy Anička's life.
facts.evidence: That I destroy her life.

facts.heading: Accommodation details for children
facts.content: The apartment where the children will stay is on the mortgage.
facts.evidence: The apartment is on the mortgage.

facts.heading: Radka marrying his brother
facts.content: Radka is getting married to his brother, at least for now.
facts.evidence: Radek is getting married to his brother, at least so far.

facts.heading: Children staying with Jana
facts.content: The children will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: The children will stay with me.

facts.heading: Jana's employment details
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Jana's teaching grades
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th graders.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th graders.

facts.heading: Neck pain while studying
facts.content: Jana goes to class with a crutch in her neck.
facts.evidence: I go to class with a crutch in my neck.

facts.heading: Feels life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels that everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Told teacher about crying
facts.content: Jana told the teacher about crying at the walk.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried at the walk.

facts.heading: Worse when alone at work
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at work and had to do something.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work, I had to do something.

facts.heading: Wakes up at 3 a.m.
facts.content: Jana wakes up at 3 a.m. every night and thinks about what is next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 a.m. and think about what's next.

facts.heading: Worries about finances
facts.content: Jana worries about not having a mortgage or a husband and how she will tell her children about money.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything.

facts.heading: Sleep schedule
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 am and gets up at 7.30 am.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 am and get up at 7.30 am.

facts.heading: Weight loss reported
facts.content: Jana has lost 4 kilos.
facts.evidence: I lost 4 kilos.

facts.heading: Support from sister and friend
facts.content: Jana has a sister in Olomouc who calls her almost every evening, and a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have a sister in Olomouc, she calls me almost every evening and my friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Fear of not being a good example
facts.content: Jana is afraid that a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mother's influence on marriage view
facts.content: Jana believes her mother influenced her view that marriage is a thing.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mum. She always said that marriage is a thing and that it's what it is.

facts.heading: Feels sad
facts.content: Jana feels sad.
facts.evidence: Sad.

facts.heading: Needs forgiveness
facts.content: Jana states she needs someone to forgive her.
facts.evidence: I need you to forgive me.

facts.heading: Crying when speaking out loud
facts.content: When Jana says her feelings out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry and I apologize.

facts.heading: Sleep aid tried
facts.content: Jana has tried cucumber tea for sleep.
facts.evidence: Cucumber tea and that's all.

facts.heading: Refusal of medication
facts.content: Jana does not want the powder the doctor offered her.
facts.evidence: Doctor offered me some powder, but I don't want to.

facts.heading: Fear of dependency
facts.content: Jana is afraid of being dependent on others.
facts.evidence: I don't want to be dependent.

facts.heading: Jana's plan for waking up
facts.content: Jana will try to sit next to the bed and write down what wakes her up.
facts.evidence: I could. At least I'll get it out of my head.

facts.heading: Jana's fear regarding children
facts.content: Jana is afraid that she will panic and cry when with children.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry. That I won't be able to stay calm.

facts.heading: Jana's goal for children
facts.content: Jana hopes children might see that sadness is allowed.
facts.evidence: Or they could see that the sadness is allowed.

facts.heading: Jana's immediate plan
facts.content: Jana plans to not be alone and not have to manage things right away today.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and I don't have to manage it right away.
